prs.author: LikiosSedo
prs.cluster_pick_reason: Both PRs target the same issue, both have unknown CI status, and both touch 5 files — so the first three criteria (CI, tests, diff size) produce no winner. The final tiebreaker is age: #1751 was opened earlier. On approach, #1751 adds an opt-in `quiet` flag that lets callers suppress the DNS rebinding warning without removing it for everyone, which is a narrower, additive change. #1776 removes the console warns from middleware entirely ("v2" label suggests it is a later rework), which is a broader behavioral removal. In the absence of CI results or test-coverage data to differentiate them concretely, #1751 wins on seniority and a more targeted, opt-in scope.

clusters.pick_reason: Both PRs target the same issue, both have unknown CI status, and both touch 5 files — so the first three criteria (CI, tests, diff size) produce no winner. The final tiebreaker is age: #1751 was opened earlier. On approach, #1751 adds an opt-in `quiet` flag that lets callers suppress the DNS rebinding warning without removing it for everyone, which is a narrower, additive change. #1776 removes the console warns from middleware entirely ("v2" label suggests it is a later rework), which is a broader behavioral removal. In the absence of CI results or test-coverage data to differentiate them concretely, #1751 wins on seniority and a more targeted, opt-in scope.
